steps: Headless, scratch HOME (qa/bots/run_batch.sh). Run A: TAG=x STRATEGIES=decent SEEDS=5 EXTRA='--choice=CORP --force-goal=25 --skills=A1,C1,C2,C3,C4 --permit=2 --reload-choice'. Same with '--choice=RELEASE' or with no skills flag and '--skills=' removed (full tree). Read errors_x.log. Run B: identical EXTRA without --reload-choice. Also seen in '--event-policy=decline --choice=alt --reload-choice' (natural win at cycle 25 on seed 5).
expected: No script error during the win choice, reload or the ending screen. Each run ends with one run_ended and one RunStats record.
actual: Run A prints 3 times 'ERROR: Lambda capture at index N was freed. Passed "null" instead.' (gdscript_lambda_callable.cpp:110), for indexes 0, 2 and 3. Run B prints none. Seen in f_fulle_CORP, f_fulle_RELEASE, f_fullx_CORP, f_fullx_RELEASE and evd (all seed 5 decent, reload path only; seeds 1-4 and the 'none' and 'A1' sets are clean). Outcome, ending, cash and stats are correct in these runs. Possible cause: the harness frees the old game root with free() after the reload, so a lambda may still hold it. Not confirmed; needs a check through the real Continue path (menu scene change) before the fix is assigned. Lambda owner UNKNOWN.

steps: TAG=t80nat STRATEGIES='decent always_expand sloppy never_expand' SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' EXTRA='--choice=alt --reload-choice' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>; compare results_t80nat.jsonl rows for decent and always_expand.
expected: always_expand (buys a ship whenever cash allows) differs from decent in path or result, or does not win ahead of it.
actual: always_expand wins 5/5 at cycles 25-26 and gives exactly the same final cash, win cycle and ending as decent on all 5 seeds (seed 1: cycle 26, cash 9498, END_ENOUGH; seed 3: cycle 25, cash 8538). So the expansion policy adds no measurable difference. It is not clearly dominant, but a second strategy that wins in the same way means expansion is not a choice. Check whether the QA always_expand policy really buys more ships than decent (bot side) and whether ship purchases are a real decision in the game.

steps: Natural runs, no --force-goal: TAG=t80nat STRATEGIES='decent always_expand' SEEDS='1 2 3 4 5' EXTRA='--choice=alt --reload-choice' qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>.
expected: Brief expectation: the natural goal is not reached (T54 on hold).
actual: The goal is reached on 10/10 runs at cycles 25-26 (choice shown at the goal cycle, cash 8538-9730). That is inside the 22-30 pacing window, so no pacing flag. The expectation in the brief looks out of date.

steps: First pass of the ending matrix (TAG=m_* with --force-goal=12 --reload-choice, decent, seeds 1-5). Count win runs whose notes lack 'reloaded from save at the win choice'.
expected: Every win run with --reload-choice reloads once at the choice.
actual: 16 wins in the first pass had no reload note (m_a1_CORP 1-5, m_a1_RELEASE 1-5, m_a1a2_RELEASE 1-4, m_none_CORP 4-5). The same batch rerun gives 80/80 with the note and no issues. The first-pass results are not used. Cause UNKNOWN.

steps: Any run: qa/bots/run_batch.sh on the Mac. See any errors_*.log.
expected: No error lines in a clean headless run.
actual: Every run prints 'ERROR: Condition "ret != noErr" is true. Returning: ""' at platform/macos/os_macos.mm:1035 (get_system_ca_certificates). It is not from the game and does not change results. Likely the sandbox or the macOS certificate lookup. UNKNOWN.
